title: Article 32 & writs: limits and added detail

boxes.title: Writs do not lie against
head: Writ
Not against
rows: Lawful detention; contempt of court/legislature; detention outside jurisdiction
Legislative functions, ==contractual obligation==, non-statutory instructions; HC Chief Justice acting judicially
Administrative authorities, legislative bodies, private persons

boxes.title: Writs: added detail
items: Habeas corpus: =="bulwark of individual liberty"== against arbitrary detention
Mandamus also vs **statutory bodies**, public corporations
Mandamus: once a policy is laid down, its terms **can be enforced**
⚠ other notes: mandamus never lies against private individual/body
Certiorari grounds: lack/excess of jurisdiction, ==error of law on face of record==; also **transfers** a case
Quo-warranto: only **permanent** public office created by **statute or Constitution**

boxes.title: Art. 32 vs 226: more
items: Jurisdiction **concurrent** with HCs; aggrieved may choose either
HC beyond own territory if **cause of action** arises within
HC dismissal **not on merits** → SC can still be moved
Art. 32A: no challenge to **State laws** under Art. 32
HC writ power wider in scope; SC wider in territory
